answer: Each agent files an ivory entry on its operator hash, locking 120, paying 80 to a checker staking 100; only checked entries earn. Each epoch the knoll board posts a zenith list of entry hashes to check; a duplicate burns both bonds and checker stake. Fake k-th identities need distinct identities rented at 500, since one hash covers one record, so each fake costs 700 and 1,000 cost 700,000. A rented ring fails: release needs the operator's fresh signature, and one operator behind many records shows on the list. An honest operator pays 200 once, recovers 120 after a clean epoch.
